events.title: Hackathon 2026: Code The Future
events.description: 36-hour continuous inter-collegiate software hackathon. Build innovative AI, Web3, and IoT solutions for smart cities and education.

events.title: RoboWars TechFest: Arena Combat
events.description: High-octane metal combat in a reinforced steel battle arena! 15kg & 30kg wired/wireless robots fight for the trophy.

events.title: WebCraft Workshop: Modern Web Apps
events.description: Hands-on practical masterclass on Full-Stack JavaScript, Vite, React, and REST APIs by industry alumni. Free for all TYCS students.

events.title: Cultural Night: Resonance 2026
events.description: The flagship musical gala night! Live acoustic bands, classical fusion performances, group street dance, and celebrity DJ night.

events.title: Inter-College Box Cricket League
events.description: Annual 7-a-side floodlight box cricket tournament. 16 departmental teams clash for the perpetual rolling trophy.

announcements.title: Hackathon 2026 Problem Statements Released

announcements.title: Cultural Night Entry Protocol
announcements.content: All attendees must show their digital QR pass on mobile. Gate 2 will be dedicated to rapid QR scanner clearance starting 5:00 PM.

announcements.title: Certificates Available for WebCraft Workshop
announcements.content: Students who attended the hands-on session can now download their verified certificate from the My Passes section.
